value.body: Public-sector banks hire Chartered Accountants as specialist officers for credit appraisal, accounts, internal audit, taxation and financial reporting. Posts are typically at Scale I or Scale II, with experience needed for higher grades. Banks advertise these posts in their own notices, not through the common IBPS PO exam.

items.label: MMGS-II basic pay
items.source: Bank officer pay scale under the 12th Bipartite Settlement, per bank notices (as reported)

items.label: Selection
items.value: Shortlisting + interview; some banks add an online test
items.note: Per SBI and other bank SO notices

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Be a qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI member); many posts ask for post-qualification experience, for example in bank audit or credit. Watch SBI and other public-sector bank 'specialist cadre officer' notices, apply online, and go through shortlisting, an interview and sometimes a written or online test.

value.title: At a glance
items: Notices are irregular and post counts are usually small.
The work is within the bank's credit, audit, tax or finance teams, with transferable postings.
Pay is lower than many private-sector CA roles, in exchange for government-bank job security.
